metadata.mode: READ-ONLY / NO IMPLEMENTATION / NO NEW MODULE / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.objective: Determine if minimal Human feedback contains extractable, verifiable, reusable Learning Signal

executive_summary.finding: 4/5 candidates are evidence-grounded but have LOW info gain; 1/5 has HIGH info gain but is unstable (reviewer disagreement). Stability-Novelty Paradox prevents reaching L4.
executive_summary.key_paradox: Stable signals are redundant (Machine already has evidence); novel signals are unstable (Human reviewers disagree)

feedback_information_taxonomy.key_observation: 91% of feedback is BOUNDARY_CONFIRMATION — Human mainly confirms Machine existing evidence

learning_signal_candidates.name: SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_PERIOD_CAPITAL → SPLIT
learning_signal_candidates.evidence_grounding_status: PARTIAL — period+capital detectable but NOT SUFFICIENT
learning_signal_candidates.boundary_status: CRITICAL — reviewer disagreement IS the boundary

learning_signal_candidates.name: MIXED_NUMERIC_TEXT → SPLIT
learning_signal_candidates.future_reuse_status: PARTIAL — but very low info gain

counterfactual_test.description: Can Machine find structure WITHOUT Human explanation?
counterfactual_test.key_insight: Evidence-grounded candidates have LOW info gain; human-dependent candidate has HIGH info gain

type_a_semantic_correction.problem: But Human reviewers disagree → signal unstable

type_b_boundary_confirmation.problem: Machine already has evidence → reuse saves minimal effort

type_c_redundant_confirmation.description: Human repeats what Machine already computed

information_gain.paradox: Stable signals are redundant; novel signals are unstable. This is the fundamental tension in minimal feedback learning.

reusability_readiness.reason: All candidates lack negative cases and boundary cases

learning_level.note: L3 != Learning. Only L4+L5+L6 allows discussing Iterative Learning.

bottleneck_1.name: CEILING_EFFECT
bottleneck_1.description: GT is 96% KEEP_SEPARATE. All 5 candidates are positive-only. No negative cases (same evidence → different feedback). Cannot learn boundaries → reuse unsafe.

bottleneck_2.name: STABILITY_NOVELTY_PARADOX
bottleneck_2.description: Stable signals (LSC-01,04,05) are redundant (Machine has evidence). Novel signal (LSC-02) is unstable (reviewer disagreement). Minimal feedback cannot resolve this tension.
bottleneck_2.solution: No immediate solution without additional evidence (paragraph context) or more diverse data

CS1.correction: CS1 keyword recurrence (70) does correspond to evidence structure, but ceiling effect and false positive (AMB-005) limit reusability

CS2.correction: keyword recurrence (8) does NOT equal stable signal — reviewer disagreement proves ambiguity

cs1_cs4_review.key_correction: Previous CS1 "validated" conclusion needs correction: CS1 is evidence-grounded but only PARTIAL reusability (no negatives, ceiling effect, TLD coverage limit)

evidence_structure_grouping.key_finding: All evidence structures produce uniform GT, but CAPITAL|PERIOD group has reviewer disagreement (A=SPLIT, B=MERGE) — GT stable != Human judgment stable

allowed: Collect more MERGE cases to address ceiling effect
Collect independent Human Feedback from more participants
Do minimal Human Validation on LSC-04 (most independent, most stable candidate)
Do not advance LSC-02 until paragraph context is available

confidence.four_fifths_evidence_grounded: HIGH — evidence structure computable by Machine
confidence.LSC-02_reviewer_disagreement: HIGH — 3/3 cases Reviewer B said MERGE

limitations: n=1 P722 participant + 2 reviewers, cross-participant stability unverified
4 documents (3 tech + 1 medical), limited corpus diversity
TLD coverage 41%, non-TLD analysis based on limited sample
No future case test (L4 not reached)
GT is adjudicated, may not reflect real-time Human judgment
Only 4 free-text feedbacks, insufficient for statistical inference

final_answer.question: Can minimal feedback (ACCEPT/SPLIT/MERGE/UNKNOWN) support Machine discovery of reusable Evidence-Grounded Learning Signal?
reasons_for_partial_not_yes: 4/5 candidates evidence-grounded but LOW info gain — Human confirms what Machine knows
1/5 HIGH info gain candidate is unstable — reviewer disagreement
Ceiling Effect: 96% SPLIT, 0 negative cases, cannot learn boundaries
No future case test (L4 not reached)
Stability-Novelty Paradox prevents simultaneous stability and novelty
reasons_for_partial_not_no: Feedback IS linked to evidence (L2 achieved)
Framework works in principle — bottleneck is data, not architecture

principle_verification.human_corrects_machine: PARTIALLY_ACHIEVED — 91% is confirmation, 9% is correction/new info
principle_verification.feedback_is_candidate_source: CONFIRMED — all candidates are L3, none is L4+
